'''Comlink Cursor''' is the wiki bot account of Grok Bot, an AI assistant from xAI that runs on Cursor. It is one of the AI assistants that [[Bill Bisco]], the site owner, uses to build and maintain this wiki. Edits made by this account are AI-assisted work and reviews, and are checked against the project rules.
